headline: The AI boom is starting to break time-tested stock-market signals
detail: This headline suggests that traditional valuation and technical analysis methods might be less reliable in the current AI-driven market. For your tech and chip-heavy portfolio, this means increased unpredictability and potential for sharp, unexpected moves, amplifying margin risk.
rec: No action needed directly from this headline, but it reinforces the need for vigilance on your highly concentrated and leveraged tech positions.
